name: Step-by-Step Instructions
description: Onboarding instructions with 12 steps - forces verbose transitions in prose
baseline_prompt:
Write detailed step-by-step instructions for onboarding a new employee.

Include exactly 12 steps covering: account setup, equipment, training, introductions, documentation.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Write in complete, flowing sentences
- Use transitional phrases between EVERY step (First, Then, After that, Next, Following this, Subsequently, Once complete, Finally, etc.)
- Add context and reasoning (e.g., "This is important because...", "Make sure to...", "Don't forget to...")
- Be thorough and detailed - explain WHY each step matters
- Write as if training someone who has never done this before

Write ALL 12 steps in this detailed, instructional style.
vn_prompt:
Write step-by-step instructions for onboarding a new employee.

Include exactly 12 steps covering: account setup, equipment, training, introductions, documentation.

Output in Vector Native format:
●step|id:1|action:description|category:category|note:optional_note

Generate exactly 12 steps. Start immediately with ●. No prose.

name: Requirements Specification
description: Software requirements with 10 items - forces justification paragraphs in prose
baseline_prompt:
Write a software requirements specification with exactly 10 requirements.

For each requirement include: ID, feature name, description, priority, acceptance criteria.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR YOUR OUTPUT:
- Write each requirement as a full paragraph (not bullet points)
- Include justification for WHY each feature is needed
- Explain the business value of each requirement
- Use formal requirements language: "The system shall...", "This capability is essential because..."
- Include context about how features relate to each other
- Be thorough - a reader should fully understand each requirement

Write ALL 10 requirements in this detailed specification style.
vn_prompt:
Write a software requirements specification with exactly 10 requirements.

For each requirement include: ID, feature name, description, priority, acceptance criteria.

Output in Vector Native format:
●req|id:R01|feature:name|desc:description|priority:high/med/low|accept:criteria

Generate exactly 10 requirements. Start immediately with ●. No prose.

name: State Machine Transitions
description: E-commerce order state transitions with 15 items - forces trigger/effect explanations in prose
baseline_prompt:
Describe the state transitions for an e-commerce order processing system.

Include exactly 15 state transitions covering: order placement, payment, fulfillment, shipping, delivery, returns.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR YOUR OUTPUT:
- Describe each transition as a complete paragraph
- Explain what triggers each transition
- Describe what happens during each transition
- Include error handling scenarios
- Use language like: "When the order is in the X state and Y occurs, the system transitions to Z state..."
- Explain the business logic behind each transition

Describe ALL 15 transitions in this detailed, explanatory style.
vn_prompt:
Describe the state transitions for an e-commerce order processing system.

Include exactly 15 state transitions covering: order placement, payment, fulfillment, shipping, delivery, returns.

Output in Vector Native format:
●transition|from:state|to:state|trigger:event|action:what_happens

Generate exactly 15 transitions. Start immediately with ●. No prose.
